elements.name: pointer motion does not poll display metadata per event

steps.name: the serial output should contain "bloom: registered bristle pointer sink" within 60s
the serial output should contain "ps2_mouse: bristle pid=" within 60s
the serial output should contain "ps2_mouse: sample rate set to" within 60s
I wait for the shell prompt
I type "loglevel 5" on the serial console
the latest serial output should contain "Log level set to 5"
I type "echo poll-baseline" on the serial console
the latest serial output should contain "bloom: pointer moved"
the latest serial output should contain at most 8 occurrences of "DISP: DISPLAY_OP_GET_INFO requested"
the latest serial output should contain at most 12 occurrences of "VFS: sys_fs_open path='/session/wayland/"
